name: rivaly-txline-worker
description: Always-on TxLINE scores stream consumer. Deployed separately from the Next app (Render free tier has no background workers, so this runs as a web service with a /health endpoint).
//: Deliberately NOT type:module. It shares modules from ../src/lib, whose nearest package.json is the repo root (CommonJS, as Next expects) — so under NodeNext those compile to CJS while worker files would compile to ESM, and the mix breaks named imports. Keeping everything CJS avoids that.
